The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case.
Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party no. 2.

He further submits that the opposite party no. 2 has filed a maintenance case in the court below and the court below has directed the petitioner to pay Rs. 6,000/- (Six Thousand) to the Patna High Court CR.

MISC. 
No.79783 of 2023(2) dt.14-12-2023 opposite party no. 2.
4.
